overview: OpenAI rolls out BioBasicsBench to gauge AI agents on wet‑lab tasks, highlighting practical scientific utility.
OpenAI secures $11 billion, reaching a $1.25 trillion valuation amid IPO delays and competitive pressure from Anthropic.
AWS expands AI infrastructure: SageMaker adds GPU partitioning and Bedrock AgentCore powers autonomous security operations.

top.title: Measuring how AI agents handle everyday wet-lab science
top.summary: OpenAI released BioBasicsBench, a 100‑task benchmark assessing AI agents' ability to interpret raw experimental data and perform routine wet‑lab procedures, aiming to measure practical scientific competence.

top.title: OpenAI valued at $1.25 trillion, as rival Anthropic nears its IPO
top.summary: OpenAI’s latest funding round values the company at $1.25 trillion after raising $11 billion; CEO Sam Altman emphasizes safety over an imminent IPO, while rival Anthropic moves toward its own public offering.

top.title: OpenAI reportedly raises an additional $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation
top.summary: TechCrunch reports OpenAI’s $11 billion raise in a funding round targeting a $1.25 trillion valuation, with the total round expected near $20 billion, reflecting a scaled‑back goal from earlier $30 billion ambitions.

top.title: Anthropic IPO buyers see valuation as low as $1.1T
top.summary: Discussion on Hacker News notes that investors considering Anthropic’s IPO are pricing the company as low as $1.1 trillion, below earlier expectations.

top.title: SageMaker Inference now supports Multi-Instance GPU to maximize GPU utilization for model endpoints
top.summary: AWS SageMaker Inference now supports NVIDIA Multi‑Instance GPU partitioning, allowing multiple models to share a single GPU with isolated resources, improving utilization and reducing costs.

top.title: How Greenlight Financial built an autonomous SOC solution on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
top.summary: Greenlight Financial built Luna, an autonomous SOC using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, handling 3‑4 k monthly security alerts with a tiered multi‑agent system, achieving seconds‑level triage.
